name: Western / Frontier
definition: Characters negotiate law, violence, land, and belonging where institutions are weak, contested, or arriving, and every claim to order carries a history.
negative_signals: modern city crime with western clothing only
empty frontier without prior inhabitants or claims
diagnostic_questions: Is legitimacy of law or possession central?
Does the landscape shape power and community rather than decorate action?

neighbors.distinction: A western may contain vengeance, but its broader promise concerns frontier order and belonging.
Frontier conflict lacks the stable command structure defining a war mission.

reader_promises.name: Contested order
reader_promises.description: Dramatize who can make, enforce, resist, or redefine rules at the frontier.

reader_promises.name: Land and history
reader_promises.description: Make place carry resources, memory, prior claims, and practical constraints.

roles.name: Skilled outsider
roles.description: Enters a community with useful force or knowledge and uncertain belonging.

roles.name: Community builder
roles.description: Pursues durable order through law, care, trade, or collective action.

roles.name: Powerful claimant
roles.description: Uses wealth, violence, paperwork, or inheritance to control land and people.

stakes: Survival of a settlement or people
Whether violence becomes the lasting law
motifs: Arrival of roads, fences, or institutions

movements.name: Arrival or encroachment
movements.description: Introduce a person or force that destabilizes the frontier's current balance.

movements.name: Claims tested
movements.description: Expose competing histories and methods of authority through concrete disputes.

movements.name: Choice of order
movements.description: Force characters to decide what rules and alliances they will make real.

movements.name: Legacy
movements.description: Show what remains after confrontation: institution, exile, reconciliation, or repeated violence.

complications.name: Law is owned
complications.description: Formal authority serves a claimant rather than a broadly legitimate order.

complications.name: Old violence returns
complications.description: A prior act undermines the protagonist's present claim to justice.

complications.name: Resource shift
complications.description: Water, transport, labor, or weather changes the balance of power.

twists.name: Title has a history
twists.description: A legal claim conceals dispossession, fraud, or a surviving prior agreement.

twists.name: Outsider's purpose
twists.description: The apparent hired gun seeks departure, repair, or testimony rather than ownership.

conclusions.name: Community law
conclusions.description: Collective action establishes a more legitimate but imperfect order.

conclusions.name: Outsider departs
conclusions.description: Violence resolves the immediate threat but leaves building to the community.

conclusions.name: Frontier redefined
conclusions.description: The ending rejects the premise of empty land and recognizes layered belonging.

variation_axes.question: What is arriving at the frontier?

subversions: Center the people who sustain community after the gunfight.
Treat the frontier as an occupied crossroads rather than empty space.
cliches_to_avoid: Indigenous people used as scenery or obstacle
quality_checks: Land and infrastructure materially affect the conflict.
Claims to authority have specific sources and contradictions.
The ending shows who must live under the new order.

sources.title: The Team Film Genre
sources.contribution: Connects western semantics with group formation, objective, differentiated roles, and coda.

sources.title: The Outcasts of Poker Flat
sources.contribution: Summarizes recognizable western conventions involving frontier, moral categories, isolation, and showdown.
